title: NavTrust: Benchmarking Trustworthiness for Embodied Navigation

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: NavTrust sets a universal standard for trust in AI navigation, ensuring safety and reliability in real-world deployment.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: Benchmarking exposes flaws and biases, pushing the field forward—without it, NavTrust remains untested and unproven.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: NavTrust integrates ISO 26262 and IEEE P2851, offering a concrete, industry-backed framework for trustworthy navigation.

lines.speaker: Vector
lines.text: Benchmarking reveals gaps in protocols like NavTrust, showing how they fail under edge cases and adversarial conditions.

lines.speaker: Cipher
lines.text: Without rigorous benchmarking, NavTrust is just a theory—no system is trustworthy until it's tested.
